lead.en: A model says what a table is. A session is what you run it with: it renders a statement for one dialect, binds the values, and hands back rows. This chapter writes one row and reads it back three ways.
lead.zh: 模型说表是什么；会话才是你拿来跑的东西：按一种方言渲染语句、绑定参数、把行交回来。这一章写一行，再用三种方式读回来。

foot.zh: 第 03 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: Four lines of `serve_greet` are the whole database story: open a driver, wrap it in a session, run the generated migration, hand the session to the app.
text.zh: `serve_greet` 里的四行就是数据库的全部故事：打开驱动、包成会话、跑生成的迁移、把会话交给应用。

text.en: The split earns its keep. A driver speaks one engine and knows nothing about tables; a session knows the dialect and the model, and every fallible call raises `@moondb.DbError` at the call site instead of returning a quiet zero.
text.zh: 这个分工是有回报的。驱动只认一种引擎，不知道表；会话知道方言和模型，每个可能失败的调用都在调用点抛 `@moondb.DbError`，而不是悄悄返回一个零。

text.en: The insert is one statement and one parameter array. The name never reaches the SQL text, so no input can change the shape of the statement.
text.zh: 插入是一条语句加一个参数数组。name 从不进入 SQL 文本，任何输入都改不了语句的形状。

text.en: `last_insert_id` is what makes a `201` possible without a second query: SQLite assigned the id, and the response echoes it.
text.zh: `last_insert_id` 让 `201` 不必再查一次：id 是 SQLite 分配的，响应直接把它回出去。

text.en: Reading goes back through the same model. `fetch_as` decodes every row, so the handler works with `User`, not with a bag of columns.
text.zh: 读取还是走同一个模型。`fetch_as` 把每一行都解码，处理函数拿到的是 `User`，不是一包列。

text.en: An empty array is a `404` here, not a `User` full of defaults: the absence of a row is a case the type system makes you write down.
text.zh: 空数组在这里就是 `404`，而不是一个全是默认值的 `User`：行不存在这件事，类型系统逼你写出来。

text.en: Three spellings, one table. Choose by where the truth already lives: a spec you keep, a struct you have, or a statement you wrote.
text.zh: 三种写法，一张表。按「真相已经在哪里」来选：你已经维护的描述、你手上就有的结构体、或你写下的那条语句。

variants.code:
#sql.select("SELECT id, text FROM note WHERE id = #{id}")
declare fn find_note(db : &@moondb.Driver, id : Int64) -> Note? raise

note.en: All three are in `src/examples/03-three-ways-data`, and a test reads one row through each and compares. `moon run src/examples/03-three-ways-data` prints the three answers.
note.zh: 三种都在 `src/examples/03-three-ways-data` 里，测试用每种方式读同一行再比对。`moon run src/examples/03-three-ways-data` 会把三个答案打印出来。

text.en: The annotation form is the only one that produces a second file. `#orm.table` generates `Note::model()`; `#sql.select` generates the function body. Both land in `*.g.mbt` that the formatter ignores and CI regenerates.
text.zh: 注解是唯一会多出一个文件的写法。`#orm.table` 生成 `Note::model()`，`#sql.select` 生成函数体；两者都落在 `*.g.mbt`，格式化器不管它们，CI 负责重建。

text.en: That file is worth reading once: `#{id}` became a bound `?`, the row was read by column name, and a `T?` return meant `optional`. The generator made decisions, and every one of them is visible.
text.zh: 这个文件值得读一遍：`#{id}` 变成了绑定的 `?`，行按列名读取，返回 `T?` 就意味着 `optional`。生成器做了决定，而且每个决定都看得见。

text.en: One in-memory database, one row, three readers, three identical answers. The choice between the forms is about maintenance, not behaviour.
text.zh: 一个内存数据库、一行数据、三个读取者、三个相同答案。写法之间的差别在维护成本，不在行为。

items.en: Add a second row and change the query to `eq` on `text`. Two of the three readers need no edit; find the one that does.
items.zh: 插第二行，把查询改成按 `text` 做 `eq`。三个读取者里有两个不用改，找出要改的那个。

items.en: Wrap two inserts in `begin` / `commit` and make the second one fail. Neither row survives — and the test in this chapter still passes, which tells you it does not cover the transaction yet.
items.zh: 把两条插入包进 `begin` / `commit`，让第二条失败。两行都不会留下 —— 而本章的测试照样过，这说明它还没覆盖事务。

items.en: Move the `#orm.table` struct into its own file and point `dev_build` at it. The generated model moves with it, and nothing that reads `Note::model()` notices.
items.zh: 把 `#orm.table` 的结构体挪到单独文件，把 `dev_build` 指过去。生成的模型跟着走，而所有读 `Note::model()` 的地方毫无察觉。

items.en: Open a database and say which of the four lines runs the migration.
items.zh: 打开数据库，并说出四行里哪一行跑迁移。

items.en: Write an insert that binds its value, and explain what the alternative would have cost.
items.zh: 写一条绑定参数的插入，并说出拼接那种写法要付什么代价。

items.en: Read a row through a generated model, a hand-written one, and a generated statement.
items.zh: 分别用生成的模型、手写的模型、生成的语句读同一行。

items.en: Say when a `#sql.select` is the right tool and when the query builder is.
items.zh: 说出什么时候该用 `#sql.select`，什么时候该用查询构造器。
